propositions: All in-tree structured-output consumers must route exclusively through the one-operation PydanticAIRunner facade with no bypasses or bespoke retry loops.

The output-retry allowance is a single value N computed from structured_retry_limit that seeds both the Agent retries parameter and the request UsageLimits addend, guaranteeing the request budget cannot exhaust before output repair.
With structured_retry_limit=0, the system performs exactly one Agent output attempt (zero repair retries and zero budget addend), preserving the batch abstain fail-safe.
All bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loops and compatibility delegation must be removed, leaving only the in-Agent bounded retry via ModelRetry.

The structured dispatch is single-sourced with exactly one outer agent.run_sync call on well-formed first response, and exactly two (native then prompted downgrade) only on the bug-895c regression case.
